submission.natural_language_explanation: This pole is the Latin-script / non-word side of a two-sided script detector: it is exactly zero on text that runs through a non-Latin script (Devanagari, Bengali, Thai, Tamil, Korean, Chinese, Arabic, Greek), where the same neuron's positive pole fires at +2 to +5, and in Latin-script, code and markup text it fires on tokens that are not ordinary English words - punctuation, whitespace, bracket and symbol tokens ('.', ',', newline, tab, ' (', ')', ';', '|', '_') and the sub-word pieces of unfamiliar or foreign names (' Jablonec', ' Kořenov', ' Ljubljana') - peaking at 0.14-0.17 there. So a prompt is predicted active if it contains at least one punctuation/whitespace/symbol token or the piece of an unfamiliar foreign name, and predicted inactive (0.000) if it is entirely in a non-Latin script, while plain punctuation-free sequences of familiar English words straddle the 0.042 active line (0.01-0.09, peak on a word-initial content token such as ' old' or ' progress').

जन्म
जतिंद्रनाथ सेनगुप्ता का जन्म 26 जून 1887 को पश्चिम बंगाल के पूर्व बर्धमान जिले के पाटिलपारा में उनके मामा के घर हुआ था। उनका पैतृक गांव हरिपुर था, जो पश्चिम बंगाल के नदिया जिले में शांतिपुर के पास स्थित एक गांव था।

शिक्षा और प्रारंभिक जीवन
